get_rocm_device_info: get ROCm device capability, name, and total memory for a given device ID
get_rocm_gpu_memory: get available GPU memory in gigabytes with optional distributed reduction
select_rocm_attention_backend: select the appropriate attention backend (FlashAttention, AITer, SDPA) for ROCm based on dtype and head size
optimize_rocm_vae: optimize a VAE model with ROCm-specific settings like MIOpen benchmark mode and AITer GroupNorm
check_rocm_async_support: check whether async output processing is supported given an enforce-eager setting
